annotations.title: Tax on selling vs. exchanging investment property

description: Estimates the tax on selling investment real estate outright (gain, section 1245 recapture, unrecaptured 1250 gain at up to 25%, 0/15/20% capital gains stacked on other income, 3.8% NIIT, state tax, cash left) and, when a replacement price is given, the 1031 exchange result: cash and mortgage boot, tax on the boot, gain deferred and replacement basis. 2025 or 2026 federal brackets. Same engine as the 1031.help calculator.

cash_added.description: Extra cash added beyond the sale proceeds. Default 0.

depreciation.description: Total depreciation taken or allowable. Default 0.

depreciation_personal_property.description: Part of depreciation taken on personal property (cost segregation, bonus). Default 0.

filing_status.description: single, mfj (married filing jointly), mfs (married filing separately), hoh (head of household), estates_trusts.

include_niit.description: Include the 3.8% net investment income tax. False only for a real estate professional whose property was a trade or business.

mortgage_paid_off.description: Loan paid off at the sale closing. Default 0.

new_loan.description: New loan on the replacement. Default 0.

other_taxable_income.description: Other taxable income that year, after deductions. Default 0.

purchase_price.description: Original purchase price plus buying costs.

replacement_price.description: Replacement property price. Give it to also get the exchange (boot) result.

state.description: Two-letter state you will owe tax to, e.g. CA. Omit to leave state tax out.

name: estimate_exchange_tax
